secrets.title: Hidden armor room
secrets.note: Enter the marked S1 access area on the right-hand route. Script 8 opens D16 and spawns an Arachnoid inside. The reward is 25 armor in this ROM; the guide calls it Medium Armor.
secrets.status: Guide description corroborated by room, item, guardian and opening script
